profile.purpose: Reviewable virtual prototype; not an OEM acceptance specification

basis.project: Supplied presentation: +/-15 V gate, <=20 W driver, <=5000 A/us, 0.2-0.8 V diode forward, reverse open, <=2 mA busbar insulation leakage, ~10 us saturation-fault shutdown, 100 Vrms 25 kHz supply, fiber interface.
basis.surrogate: onsemi public datasheet: 1200 V, +/-20 V gate, 201 A IGBT pulsed and 84 A diode repetitive peak ratings with conditions; 2.85 V maximum at 80 A/+15 V/25 C; 300 uA blocking and 300 nA gate leakage; 150 C junction maximum.
basis.engineering: All tolerances, test currents and dwells omitted by the brief, 100 V/10 uA diode reverse test, optical latency, energy budgets and their linear V*I scaling, access thresholds, validity envelope and reset temperature are explicit prototype assumptions. The 5 us fault deadline is a conservative prototype screen informed by the surrogate's conditional short-circuit rating; it is not a survival model.
basis.temperature: VCE limit above 25 C uses +0.0004 V/C assumed offset; thermal C, threshold/gm temperature coefficients and energy scaling are unvalidated.

qualification_blockers: Exact locomotive assembly, semiconductor, driver, diode, busbar and cooling part numbers are unavailable.
OEM acceptance conditions, limits, interface pinout, optical protocol and fault semantics are unapproved.
No measured switching, leakage, thermal or fault traces have been supplied for correlation.
Nonlinear capacitance, diode reverse recovery, detailed driver electronics and full safe operating area are not validated.
Independent physical protection, insulation coordination, fixture loads and instrument uncertainty require engineering review and commissioning.

limitations: Not calibrated to the locomotive module.
Constant capacitances and approximate carrier response; diode reverse recovery omitted.
Illustrative lumped thermal network; no thermal runaway, avalanche, physical damage or EMI model.
Upper and lower tests use mirrored terminal references; no simultaneous PWM leg or OEM optical protocol.
Full SOA and exact assembly interfaces remain unverified.
MODEL PASS covers only the listed checks, not hardware release.
